assessments.reasoning: The inspected title or publisher description identifies the enrolled IEEE 1364-2005 Verilog public catalog authority. Retained native HTTP 200 bytes match SHA-256 d27012db5520a45d4a9690cb2d13ff56bef0e03489fd429b70f7415f6ed88633. Inspected the exact text described by IEEE SA IEEE-1364-2005 publisher catalog, standard heading and main description. IEEE's 1364-2005 catalog identifies Verilog as the hardware description language defined by that standard. The identity is scoped to the Verilog language named by the base-language standard. IEEE's later merger and separately governed extensions have distinct scopes. The defining description identifies the language named by the standard. Later standards and filename conventions cannot determine conformance to that edition.
